acceptance_predicates.description: Qualification binds exact ASB and TUI protected-main commits and trees.
Installed TUI completes the real broker/control handshake under a PTY and remains interactive.
Record, seal, reopen, replay, compare, retry, cancel, stale-session, and remove paths are positively and negatively qualified.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management remain warnings and never block.
Independent review and exact-head hosted checks pass.

definition_of_done: A live exact-main PTY/control transcript exists for the paired ASB/TUI route.
Lifecycle and offline evidence is digest-bound and independently reviewed.

gates.description: The actual installed TUI child completes the authenticated development broker handshake and interactive loop.
Trusted-main and repository-quality checks pass on the exact qualified heads.
